name: printed-loop-wand
status: Provisional first print set. Model geometry is generated and checked; printed fit, strength, comfort and mass are not measured.
frame: Assembly axes: +Z runs from the handle butt (z = 0) to the tip, +Y is the button side, the loop hangs toward -Y. Angles are measured from +Y toward +X, which is clockwise seen from the tip.

printer_reference.note: Reference profile only. Slicer estimates are recorded in the README; nothing has been physically printed.

xiao.boards: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 Sense, or XIAO MG24 Sense; which one this wand carries is not physically confirmed. Both document a 21 x 17.8 mm footprint (Seeed wiki).

glb.units: metres, Y up, wand along +Z; assemblies stacked 130 mm apart in -Y
metres, Y up, wand along +Z; assemblies stacked 130 mm apart in -Y
